summary: Tested iteration 12 features: Admin Special Days CRUD and Birthdays Bulk-Import + new Birthdays/Special-days tabs. Wrote pytest suite (6 tests, all passing after fix). Found + fixed a backend 500 on POST /api/admin/special-days (ObjectId leak). Ran Playwright flow on admin UI: both tabs render, dialogs work, create/edit/delete for Special Days succeeds, Birthday photo UI is fully removed, Employees tab no longer embeds BirthdayEditor.
action_items: None blocking — backend fix already applied. Main agent should review the small server.py change (POST /admin/special-days response builder no longer relies on mutated insert doc).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /admin/special-days returned dict was built from `{**doc}` after insert_one, which mutates `doc` with `_id: ObjectId`, causing FastAPI JSON serialization to blow up with a 500. Fixed by explicitly listing returned keys. Same anti-pattern should be audited elsewhere in server.py (e.g., other `insert_one` handlers) — the manual verification note claimed this worked, but it never did on a fresh run.
Bulk-import auto-creates users with password = employee_number in plaintext hash — this is documented but should ideally force-reset on first login (not tested here, just an observation).
AdminDashboard.jsx is ~1200+ lines; consider splitting per-tab components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Tests self-clean: create TEST special day on 07-19/07-20 and delete; bulk-import creates TESTBD001/TESTBD002 and deletes them at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 backend + frontend green after ObjectId-serialization fix in POST /admin/special-days. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_special_days_birthdays.py. UI: Admin tabs order is Report, Insights, Bookings, Emergency, Employees, Birthdays, Special days, Holidays, Menu, Audit. `data-testid` coverage is solid on both new editors.
rca of the issue: POST /api/admin/special-days built response as `{'id': str(res.inserted_id), **{k:v for k,v in doc.items() if k != 'created_at'}}`. Motor's insert_one mutates the doc argument to include `_id` (ObjectId), so the response body ended up with a raw ObjectId → FastAPI serializer raised ValueError → 500. Repro: as admin, POST any valid special day. Fix: return an explicit dict of the four public fields instead of splatting `doc`.
